comparison: Construct the finite image of integer exponents j=0,...,b under j↦2^j*lambda_L, retaining the exact endpoint lambda_U=2^b*lambda_L. For positive lambda_L the map is injective, so the set has b+1 distinct values and the logarithmic cardinality formula follows after real casts and positivity. If lambda_L=0, all values collapse and the logarithmic ratio is undefined in the source sense; do not rely on totalized real division/logarithms. comparison: For a C2 function on the stated smooth manifold, require every constrained critical point to be either a global minimizer on the manifold or to have a tangent direction with strictly negative Hessian quadratic form. In a local chart, vanishing first derivative and the second iterated derivative provide a coordinate formulation; at a critical point the sign property is invariant under valid smooth chart changes, but proving that identification remains necessary. Restrict derivatives to tangent/chart coordinates rather than taking the ambient Hessian on normal directions. IsMinOn expresses the global value inequality and must be combined with membership in the manifold; it does not supply existence of a minimizer. Strict negativity must not become nonpositive curvature, and global benignity does not assert unique minima, nondegenerate minima or convergence of an arbitrary optimization algorithm. The source least-eigenvalue notation can be related to a negative direction in the finite-dimensional self-adjoint Hessian setting.
gap: Minimizer predicates and chart derivatives express global benignity, with the manifold/chart Hessian and negative-direction identifications to be established.

comparison: Represent f*(x) as the finite real dot product beta*·x and Y_i as f*(X_i)+epsilon_i, equivalently a design-matrix product plus noise. The centered-noise phrase requires finite expectations equal to zero; using a total real integral equal to zero without integrability would not express centering. Preserve that p may greatly exceed n and do not infer full column rank, invertibility or coefficient identifiability. This introductory decomposition does not itself impose independence of the noise and design, a Gaussian law, sparsity or a joint conditional product law. The saved later conditional-noise scope must remain separate, including the distinction between scalar conditioning on X_i and conditioning jointly on the full design.
gap: Finite dot products and matrix multiplication directly express the regression decomposition, with integrable centering and later statistical assumptions kept separate.
